description.text: A collection launched on 20 March 2026 with nine illustration rare–style promos of the first partners of Kanto, Sinnoh and Alola. Each collection held a pack of three of the nine, with two more booster packs and a sticker sheet. Side by side, each region's three cards make one long picture: Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle of Kanto, Turtwig, Chimchar and Piplup of Sinnoh, Rowlet, Litten and Popplio of Alola.
